about: Deterministic conformance corpus for the feltdb.trigger.match contract. Every case is executed by both the native and the WASM implementation and their canonical output bytes must be identical to each other and to expected_output. Cases with 'input' are canonically encoded by the harness; cases with 'raw_input' are fed to the contract verbatim so that malformed and non-canonical encodings are testable. Regenerate expected_output with FELTDB_TRIGGER_CONTRACT_BLESS=1 cargo test -p feltdb --test trigger_contract_conformance -- bless --ignored

cases.name: collection_matches
cases.why: the change is in the trigger's source collection

cases.name: collection_differs
cases.why: a change in another collection is not this trigger's

cases.name: collection_differs_by_case
cases.why: collection comparison is exact, not case-folded

cases.name: collection_differs_by_prefix
cases.why: a prefix of the source collection is not the source collection

cases.name: change_kind_update_matches
cases.why: an update trigger accepts an update

cases.name: change_kind_delete_matches
cases.why: a delete trigger accepts a delete with no value

cases.name: change_kind_insert_against_update_trigger
cases.why: an insert is not an update

cases.name: change_kind_delete_against_insert_trigger
cases.why: a delete is not an insert

cases.name: disabled_trigger_rejects_matching_change
cases.why: a disabled trigger never matches, even when everything else agrees

cases.name: disabled_trigger_outranks_collection_mismatch
cases.why: disabled is checked before collection, so the reason is stable

cases.name: predicate_absent_matches_any_value
cases.why: no predicate means collection and kind decide alone

cases.name: predicate_absent_matches_absent_value
cases.why: no predicate means a valueless change still matches

cases.name: predicate_matches_string
cases.why: the field resolves and equals the expected value

cases.name: predicate_value_mismatch
cases.why: the field resolves to a different value

cases.name: predicate_field_absent
cases.why: the field path does not resolve

cases.name: predicate_against_absent_value
cases.why: a predicate cannot be evaluated against a change that carried no record

cases.name: predicate_empty_field_path_selects_whole_value
cases.why: an empty path compares the whole record

cases.name: predicate_empty_field_path_mismatch
cases.why: an empty path comparing an unequal record

cases.name: predicate_field_on_scalar_value
cases.why: a scalar record has no members to address

cases.name: predicate_dotted_key_is_a_path_not_a_key
cases.why: a literal dotted key is not addressable, because the path splits first

cases.name: value_null_present_with_whole_record_predicate
cases.why: a record that is JSON null is present and comparable

cases.name: value_absent_with_whole_record_predicate
cases.why: an absent record is not JSON null, so the same predicate rejects

cases.name: predicate_matches_null_field
cases.why: a field whose value is null equals a null expectation

cases.name: null_field_is_not_a_missing_field
cases.why: a present null field resolves; it is not the absent case

cases.name: missing_field_does_not_equal_null
cases.why: an absent field never equals null

cases.name: null_is_not_false
cases.why: JSON null and false are different values

cases.name: nested_path_matches
cases.why: a dotted path descends through nested objects

cases.name: nested_path_mismatch
cases.why: a nested path that resolves to another value

cases.name: nested_path_stops_at_missing_segment
cases.why: an intermediate segment that does not exist stops the walk

cases.name: nested_object_equality_ignores_key_order
cases.why: objects compare as maps, so the encoded key order cannot decide

cases.name: nested_object_equality_rejects_extra_key
cases.why: an object with an extra member is a different object

cases.name: deeply_nested_value
cases.why: nesting well inside the shared recursion bound

cases.name: array_equality_matches
cases.why: arrays compare elementwise and in order

cases.name: array_order_is_significant
cases.why: the same members in another order are a different array

cases.name: array_length_is_significant
cases.why: a prefix is not the array

cases.name: array_elements_are_not_addressable
cases.why: a numeric path segment does not index an array

cases.name: array_of_objects_equality
cases.why: nested structure inside array elements participates

cases.name: empty_array_matches_empty_array
cases.why: an empty array is a value

cases.name: empty_array_is_not_empty_object
cases.why: an empty array and an empty object are different values

cases.name: integer_equality_matches
cases.why: integers compare by value

cases.name: integer_and_float_are_different_values
cases.why: 42 is not 42.0 under JSON value equality

cases.name: float_and_integer_are_different_values
cases.why: and the comparison is symmetric

cases.name: float_equality_matches
cases.why: floats compare by value

cases.name: negative_integer_matches
cases.why: negative integers are their own variant

cases.name: negative_zero_is_not_integer_zero
cases.why: the literal -0 carries a sign no integer can hold, so it decodes as a float and never equals the integer 0

cases.name: large_unsigned_integer_matches
cases.why: a u64 near the top of the range stays an integer

cases.name: smallest_signed_integer_matches
cases.why: i64::MIN stays an integer

cases.name: zero_matches_zero
cases.why: zero is an ordinary value

cases.name: zero_is_not_false
cases.why: a number and a boolean are different values

cases.name: numeric_string_is_not_a_number
cases.why: "42" is not 42

cases.name: empty_collection_names_match
cases.why: an empty collection name is compared like any other

cases.name: empty_collection_against_named_trigger
cases.why: an empty collection name is not a wildcard

cases.name: empty_object_record
cases.why: a record with no members

cases.name: empty_string_field_value
cases.why: an empty string is a value, not an absence

cases.name: empty_string_is_not_missing
cases.why: an empty string does not satisfy a non-empty expectation

cases.name: empty_key_segment_in_path
cases.why: a leading dot addresses a member whose name is the empty string

cases.name: unicode_field_and_value
cases.why: non-ASCII keys and values survive canonical encoding on both sides

cases.name: escaped_control_characters_in_value
cases.why: a value containing characters the encoder must escape

cases.name: fanout_first_trigger_matches
cases.why: one change against the first of several triggers

cases.name: fanout_second_trigger_matches
cases.why: the same change against a second, differently-predicated trigger

cases.name: fanout_third_trigger_rejects
cases.why: the same change against a third trigger that does not match

cases.name: fanout_fourth_trigger_disabled
cases.why: the same change against a disabled trigger

cases.name: malformed_not_json
cases.why: bytes that are not JSON at all

cases.name: malformed_empty_input
cases.why: zero bytes

cases.name: malformed_truncated_object
cases.why: a JSON document that ends mid-value

cases.name: malformed_trailing_content
cases.why: a complete document followed by more bytes

cases.name: malformed_trailing_comma
cases.why: a trailing comma is not JSON

cases.name: malformed_single_quotes
cases.why: single-quoted strings are not JSON

cases.name: malformed_top_level_array
cases.why: the input must be an object

cases.name: malformed_top_level_string
cases.why: the input must be an object

cases.name: malformed_missing_change
cases.why: a required member is absent

cases.name: malformed_missing_trigger
cases.why: a required member is absent

cases.name: malformed_unknown_top_level_field
cases.why: the contract denies unknown members

cases.name: malformed_unknown_trigger_field
cases.why: the contract denies unknown members in nested objects

cases.name: malformed_duplicate_field
cases.why: a repeated contract member is rejected

cases.name: malformed_change_kind_value
cases.why: change_kind is a closed set

cases.name: malformed_enabled_is_not_bool
cases.why: enabled must be a boolean, not a truthy value

cases.name: malformed_collection_is_not_string
cases.why: collection must be a string

cases.name: malformed_predicate_missing_field
cases.why: a predicate needs both members

cases.name: malformed_version_is_float
cases.why: version is an integer

cases.name: malformed_version_is_negative
cases.why: version is unsigned

cases.name: contract_id_mismatch
cases.why: a well-formed input addressed to another contract

cases.name: contract_version_unsupported
cases.why: a well-formed input at a version this implementation does not implement

cases.name: malformed_and_misaddressed
cases.why: shape is validated before identity, so this is an input error

cases.name: null_predicate_is_no_predicate
cases.why: an explicit null predicate is the absent predicate

cases.name: whitespace_around_document
cases.why: insignificant whitespace does not change the decision

cases.name: unsorted_input_keys_are_still_valid_input
cases.why: canonical ordering is how FeltDB emits input, not a parsing requirement

cases.name: unsorted_nested_keys_still_compare_equal
cases.why: object equality is by member, so a record encoded with unsorted keys still equals a sorted expectation

cases.name: duplicate_key_inside_record_resolves_last_wins
cases.why: a repeated member inside an opaque record collapses to its last value, as a map-backed decoder does

cases.name: escaped_unicode_equals_literal_unicode
cases.why: \u escapes and literal UTF-8 decode to the same string, so the encoding of the input cannot decide

cases.name: surrogate_pair_escape_decodes
cases.why: an astral character written as a surrogate pair equals the same character written literally

cases.name: exponent_notation_is_a_float
cases.why: 1e2 is a float and 100 is an integer, so they are different values

cases.name: exponent_notation_equals_decimal_float
cases.why: 1e2 and 100.0 are the same float

cases.name: integer_beyond_u64_becomes_a_float
cases.why: an integer literal too large for u64 is a float on both sides, so it cannot equal an integer

cases.name: high_precision_float_round_trips
cases.why: a float needing full precision decodes identically on both sides

cases.name: malformed_leading_zero_number
cases.why: 01 is not a JSON number

cases.name: malformed_nan_literal
cases.why: NaN is not a JSON value, and a contract that accepted it would admit a value with no equality

cases.name: malformed_raw_control_character_in_string
cases.why: an unescaped control character is not legal inside a JSON string

cases.name: malformed_lone_surrogate_escape
cases.why: an unpaired surrogate does not name a character

cases.name: negative_zero_equals_negative_zero
cases.why: -0 and -0.0 decode to the same float

cases.name: negative_zero_float_equals_positive_zero_float
cases.why: float equality is IEEE equality, under which -0.0 and 0.0 are equal

cases.name: negative_integer_beyond_i64_becomes_a_float
cases.why: a negative integer literal too small for i64 decodes as a float
